description: #192: stack.sh do_status (the read-only tool reporting where each app's DB points) enumerated env files via active_envs (glob/lexicographic order, where '.env' sorts BEFORE '.env.local') and took the FIRST occurrence of each DB key. But a Next app loads '.env.local' OVER '.env' — so a leftover '.env'=localhost (residue after a restore, or a direct boot without stack.sh shadowing) made status report the app as 🟢 practice while Next would actually boot on a '.env.local'=remote. A false-green in the very tool built to kill false-green — sibling of the #167/#176 substring/precedence family and today's text-not-match-code run. Fix: a new env_load_order(dir, fw) emits the ACTIVE env files in the FRAMEWORK load precedence (highest first), mirroring mode-banner.mjs FILES; do_status now iterates env_load_order instead of active_envs, so first-occurrence = the value the app truly loads. Framework-aware: next -> .env.development.local > .env.local > .env.development > .env; node (NestJS/@nestjs/config default) -> .env ONLY (applying next precedence to a node app would misreport a .env.local it never loads). Matched by EXACT base name, so shadowed (*.testenv-shadowed) / marker (.env.disabled) / template (.env.example) files are excluded by construction. Robust across shells: set -- positional params instead of splitting an unquoted string (bash splits, zsh would not — caught live when a sourced-into-zsh debug returned nothing). active_envs is UNCHANGED and still feeds the order-INDEPENDENT guard.sh call (fail-closed on ANY unsafe file). Sweep (#167/#176 trap), each re-audited from a fresh read: shadow_others moves aside ALL non-placed files (order-independent); guard.sh scans ALL passed files fail-closed (order-independent, correct as a gate); mode-banner.mjs FILES is ALREADY precedence-correct (the reference copied here); no prod-run subcommand reads env — do_status was the ONLY glob-order-assumes-app-load bug. Proof-of-teeth: status-env-precedence.test.sh (6 assertions, bash) + end-to-end real do_status on a temp fixture (.env=localhost + .env.local=supabase): BEFORE (glob) reported 🟢 practice (the false-green), AFTER (precedence) reports 🔴 remote (supabase.co) = what Next loads; node fixture reads .env only; shadowed/template excluded. guard.test.sh (18) + shadow-ignore-order.test.sh (5) still green; real 'bash stack.sh status' runs read-only on the live repos without error. gate_layer=infra/tooling + human-awareness.
